newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Gibson's advises no action on bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Gibson's advises no action on bid.

text.p: Flour and stockfeed miller Gibsons Ltd advised on Friday that shareholders take no action on the takeover offer from Pivot Nutrition Pty Ltd, the group's 56.71 percent shareholder.
Pivot's proposed offer of A$4.90 cash per share, ex-dividend, is for all of the shares it does not already own.

Gibson said its independent directors intend to advise shareholders of their recommendation in relation to the offer after having received advice and an independent expert's report regarding the fairness and reasonableness of the offer.
It said the offer is conditional upon receiving acceptances from at least 75 percent of shareholders and becoming entitled to a minimum of 90 percent of Gibson's shares.
Gibson's shares last traded at A$4.50 on November 4.
The proposed offer values Gibson's at A$22.40 million.
